title: DiffusionWorldViewer: Exposing and Broadening the Worldview Reflected by Generative Text-to-Image Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on demographic representation and bias (gender, race, and age) in generative text-to-image models. While it utilizes the philosophical framework of 'worldviews' to describe user beliefs and values, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
